scope: Six existing catalogue IDs gain first partial observations; BIS has two independent route snapshots. Seven represented programme/stream bodies and fee schedules were read. Three EMBA pages and P60 were separately read for unresolved boundaries. No new award, independent review or live portal conclusion.

records.scopeNote: Academic entry is assessed through alternative legal qualifications or professional admission. Some non-law applicants with at least three shipping/transport or IP-industry years may be considered only for the corresponding Maritime or IP stream. Common-law-qualified applicants cannot enter the Common Law Stream; Mainland LLB holders cannot enter Chinese and Comparative Law. Only English modules are listed for 2027/28. No stream-specific exception is applied to every LLM applicant.

A recognised university degree or accepted equivalent such as AHKIArb is considered; a law degree is not universally required. Relevant dispute-resolution work is preferred, without a mandatory year minimum. The 30-credit exempt load and 33-credit non-exempt load require school assessment; a qualifying common-law degree or PGCHKL/equivalent earned within eight years may permit the stated course exemptions. Professional recognition and arbitrator/mediator appointments are not automatic.

A recognised undergraduate qualification in the listed biological, medical, veterinary, animal, health, environmental, quantitative, management, communication, Chinese-medicine or food-science fields, or an assessed related discipline, is required. Scientific preparation is preferred, without an invented work-year minimum. Research Training, Practicum and Global are study streams, not extra degrees; Global has limited quota and may require an interview. Stream choice is made at study commencement and is not guaranteed.

A recognised Bachelor of Veterinary Medicine (BVM), Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM), or equivalent veterinary qualification is required. This is advanced study for veterinary graduates, not an entry-to-veterinary-practice conversion for any bachelor holder. Qualification recognition and professional registration remain separate assessments; no licence or right to practise is inferred.

Any recognised bachelor discipline is considered only with appropriate mathematical knowledge in the curriculum. Academic performance, motivation, potential, any relevant experience and interview performance are assessed. Information Analytics Management (IAM) and Quantitative Analysis for Business (QAB) are alternative streams under one P84 programme; repeated department listings do not create extra degrees. Shared admissions and 30-credit fee facts do not guarantee either stream allocation.

Choose a verified specific BIS stream before selecting a study option. MIS is aimed at non-IT applicants and prefers subjects outside Information Systems or Computer Science; this preference is not an automatic exclusion. FIT requires intermediate IT/IS or Finance/Accounting knowledge evidenced through fundamental courses or relevant work. The streams are alternatives, never cumulative or interchangeable requirements.

EMBA.notesEn: P12 is a global/hybrid programme with overseas tours and incomplete academic-entry details in the consulted body. P01A/P01B publish Second Class Honours/equivalent and six significant managerial years with Putonghua teaching; these are not imported into P12. P01B optional Tsinghua MPA needs separate admission and further study. Hong Kong delivery and grouped scope remain unresolved; no active route, generic English rule or fee is assigned. EMBA application fee is HKD 1000, not the ordinary HKD 600.
